intercept_logs_context_manager: use the intercept_logs context manager to capture log messages matching a regex pattern from a named logger
test_intercept_logs: test the intercept_logs function by capturing warning messages from a specific logger using a regex filter
create_log_interceptor: create a log interceptor that captures all error-level messages from a logger using a regex pattern
interactive_testing_requested_check: check if interactive testing mode is enabled by calling interactive_testing_requested which reads the PYTORCH3D_INTERACTIVE_TESTING env var
review_intercept_logs_cleanup: review the intercept_logs context manager to verify the logger filter is properly removed in the finally block
